summary: Regentis Biomaterials Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 9, 2026, reporting that its Adjourned Annual General Meeting of Shareholders approved all fourteen proposals as described in its May 28, 2026 proxy statement. This is a routine procedural filing of meeting results, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. The filing merely confirms shareholder votes on ordinary business items.
